# Daniel Ye

> Daniel Ye (Chinese name: 叶逸飞, Yifei Ye) is a Ph.D. candidate in Industrial Engineering at Iowa State University (Ames, Iowa, USA), advised by Dr. Qing Li and a member of the Center for Nondestructive Evaluation (CNDE). His research is on representing, modeling, and correcting 3D shape deformation in additive manufacturing (3D printing): predicting how a printed part departs from its CAD geometry and compensating for that deviation.

## Research topics
- Additive manufacturing (3D printing) shape accuracy
- 3D shape deformation modeling and prediction
- Predictive geometric compensation
- Computational geometry
- 3D deep learning, spatial intelligence, and generative 3D
